# Keys whose surface has not been built yet.
#
# Every key the product needs is named in src/copy.rs now, so the words can be
# reviewed and translated as one deck rather than arriving surface by surface.
# A key nothing renders is listed here until its slice lands; tests/copy.rs
# fails both when a listed key starts rendering and when an unlisted key stops,
# so the list shrinks deliberately and never drifts. It is empty when the
# product is whole.
#
# LA4 rendered the Setup assistant, its preflight and activation refusals, the
# skew rows and the Linux-only moments those carry. What is left belongs to
# surfaces nobody has built or to a fact no method publishes yet: the secret
# store row (M38 section 6.5) needs a published probe outcome, the system-scope
# refusal (M38 section 6.5, four keys below) needs a scope the typed CLI does
# not publish in its service result, and the rest are rows their own slices
# never drew.
